Jalen Johnson - Out: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game versus Indiana.
Kingston Flemings - Suspension: Flemings (suspension) won't play in Monday's game against Indiana, Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic reports.
Jock Landale - Out: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Indiana.
Mouhamed Gueye - Out: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Henri Veesaar - Out: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
Paul George - Out: George will be rested Monday against Houston.
Devin Carter - Out: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.
Egor Demin - Out: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

Nic Claxton - Out: Claxton (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the 76ers.
Peyton Watson - Out: Watson (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Thunder, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.
Jaylon Tyson - Out: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Oklahoma City.

Max Christie - Day-To-Day: Christie has been ruled out for the rest of Monday's game against the Kings due to a right hip injury, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports. He'll end the night with no points (0-5 FG, 0-5 3Pt), two rebounds and one steal in eight minutes.
Kyrie Irving - Out: Irving (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Kings.
Santi Aldama - Out: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's matchup with Sacramento.
Tarik Biberovic - Out: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.
Dereck Lively II - Out: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.
Sergio de Larrea - Out: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that de Larrea (knee) will be re-evaluated next week, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.
Spencer Jones - Out: Jones (hamstring) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Trail Blazers.
Julian Strawther - Out: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
Isaiah Joe - Out: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Hornets.
Jalen Duren - Out: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Brandon Williams - Out: Williams (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Suns.
Al Horford - Out: Horford will be rested Monday against the Suns.

Gui Santos - Out: Santos did not play in the second half of Sunday's 124-112 win over the Clippers due to a knee injury and will not play against the Suns on Monday, Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com reports.

Kristaps Porzingis - Out: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
Moses Moody - Out: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Jimmy Butler III - Out: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Clint Capela - Out: Capela (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.
Steven Adams - Out: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
Kelly Oubre Jr. - Out: Oubre (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks.
Larry Nance Jr. - Out: Nance (illness) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks.
Obi Toppin - Out: Toppin (back) will dress for Monday's game against  Hawks but will only play in an emergency, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
T.J. McConnell - Out: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Hawks and remains week-to-week.
Ivica Zubac - Out: Zubac (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks.

Pascal Siakam - Out: Siakam will be rested against the Hawks on Monday.
Johnny Furphy - Out: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.
Ben Sheppard - Out: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Tyrese Haliburton - Out: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Rui Hachimura - Out: Hachimura (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Raptors.
Derrick Jones Jr. - Out: Jones (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Raptors.

Bradley Beal - Out: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Jordan Miller - Out: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

Adou Thiero - Out: Head coach JJ Redick said Monday that Thiero (knee) has participated in live action, and the hope is that he'll be available by the end of the week, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
Scotty Pippen Jr. - Out: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pelicans.
Quinten Post - Out: Post (ankle) has been downgraded to out for Monday's game against the Pelicans.
Terrence Shannon Jr. - Out: Shannon (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Anthony Edwards - Out: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

model_check.rule: v1 is live. v2 is only PROPOSED (switch_ready) when ALL hold on the same graded legs: 100+ graded legs, lower log loss, higher avg CLV vs FanDuel AND vs Pinnacle, 30+ top picks graded and a top-pick win rate (King's Favorite/Best Parlay legs + top leg per game) at least v1's. Even then the user is asked first; it never switches on its own.

sharp_filter.note: Report only: tested live on 2026-10-25, it swapped 16 of 36 game picks and lowered the average Pinnacle-rated win chance of the picks (86.7% -> 85.9%), because the safest alt lines carry the most FanDuel vig. Since the goal is win rate, it stays off.
sharp_filter.rule: Legs dropped when FanDuel's price implies a chance more than 3 pts above Pinnacle's no-vig fair chance (you'd be overpaying vs the sharp market).
